_comment: Engine 1's corridor definition and detection thresholds. Every value cites a
named rule in the `corridor-detection` skill, which is where the argument for
it lives. This file exists so the granularity and the sensitivity are things a
reader can see and disagree with — not so they can be changed without one.
Changing a value here without changing the skill makes the citation a lie.

corridor_levels.name: issuer_method
corridor_levels.catches: An issuing bank's rail degrading while every other bank's is fine.

corridor_levels.name: method_route
corridor_levels.catches: A route or acquirer degrading across all issuers.

corridor_levels.name: issuer_method_route
corridor_levels.catches: Both at once. Off by default: at this data volume it splits the stream into ~37 buckets that individually never clear MV2, so it detects nothing and only widens the false-positive surface.

minimum_volume.note: The single most important false-positive guard. MV2 is what keeps the Phase 2 decoy corridor from firing.

significance.note: All three must hold. Each alone has a corridor shape it fails on.

diagnosis.note: The share thresholds govern the deterministic fallback only. The model is given the raw distribution and reasons about it.

recovery.note: A configured duration above the maximum is clamped, never honoured.
